**December payroll and partner payment review (Sterling, Marsh & Associates LLP)**

**Marcus Holloway was underpaid by $1,500.00 in December.** The partner schedule approves $49,500.00 a month. The GL and bank show $48,000.00 paid.

**Sources.** Gusto register pay periods 25 (paid 12/06/24) and 26 (paid 12/20/24), the partner compensation schedule, the GL detail and the chart of accounts.

### 1) Journal entries

**JE-1: December W-2 Associate payroll (5 associates, both pay dates combined)**

| | Acct # | Account name | Debit | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Dr | 6000 | Salaries - Associates | 157,538.48 | |
| Dr | 6100 | Employer Payroll Taxes | 8,555.78 | |
| Dr | 6120 | 401(k) Employer Match | 4,726.16 | |
| Cr | 2100 | Accrued Payroll (net pay) | | 105,999.18 |
| Cr | 2200 | Payroll Taxes Payable (employee 50,057.30 + employer 8,555.78) | | 58,613.08 |
| Cr | 2210 | 401(k) Withholding Payable (employer match; no associate deferrals) | | 4,726.16 |
| Cr | 2220 | Health Insurance Withholding Payable (employee share) | | 1,482.00 |
| | | **Total** | **170,820.42** | **170,820.42** |

- **Pay date 12/06 (period 25).** Debits are 6000 $30,769.24, 6100 $2,097.30 and 6120 $923.08. Credits are 2100 $19,831.72, 2200 $12,293.82, 2210 $923.08 and 2220 $741.00. Both sides total $33,789.62.
- **Pay date 12/20 (period 26).** This includes $96,000.00 of bonuses. Debits are 6000 $126,769.24, 6100 $6,458.48 and 6120 $3,803.08. Credits are 2100 $86,167.46, 2200 $46,319.26, 2210 $3,803.08 and 2220 $741.00. Both sides total $137,030.80.
- **Employer health premium.** The $4,446.00 for associates is not in this entry. The GL books it in 6110 through the monthly premium entry, which is $12,852.00 a month for all staff.
- **Gross wages tie to the GL.** 6000 in the GL for PR25 and PR26 is $30,769.24 + $126,769.24 = $157,538.48.
- **Employer taxes differ from the GL.** The register's employer taxes include workers' comp. The GL's 6100 and 2200 for PR25 appear to leave it out. For associates, workers' comp is $945.22 of the $8,555.78. I followed the register.
- **Other roles.** For the other W-2 roles (Of-Counsel, Paralegal, Legal Assistant, Administrative, Bookkeeper), total December gross is $170,294.22. All W-2 gross is $327,832.70 and all-in employer cost is $368,078.87. I did not prepare separate entries for those roles.

**JE-2: Marcus Holloway, December guaranteed payment**

The original payment is already in the GL. JE-OB-000807 posted it on 12/02 as Dr 6200 / Cr 1000 for $48,000.00. The correcting entry below brings it to the approved $49,500.00.

| | Acct # | Account name | Debit | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Dr | 6200 | Partner Guaranteed Payments | 1,500.00 | |
| Cr | 1000 | Operating Checking - First Keystone Bank | | 1,500.00 |
| | | **Total** | **1,500.00** | **1,500.00** |

If the $1,500.00 is not paid right away, credit 2050 Accrued Expenses instead of 1000.

### 2) Total partner payment

**GL check.** All 96 guaranteed-payment lines (8 partners × 12 months) are booked to 6200, totaling $4,584,000.00. None are in salary accounts. The Q4 profit distributions are correctly in 3100 Partner Draws, totaling $799,999.98.

| | Amount |
|---|---|
| December guaranteed payments paid (8 partners) | 382,000.00 |
| December guaranteed payments approved | 383,500.00 |
| Full-year guaranteed payments paid (6200) | 4,584,000.00 |
| Q4 profit distribution paid 12/27 (3100) | 799,999.98 |
| **Total partner payments for 2024** | **5,383,999.98** |

The schedule's own total of $5,383,999.98 matches what was paid. Its approved annual guaranteed payments total $4,602,000.00, which is $18,000.00 more than was paid.

### 3) Marcus Holloway variance

| | Monthly | Annual |
|---|---|---|
| Approved (partner schedule) | 49,500.00 | 594,000.00 |
| Actual (GL 6200 and bank) | 48,000.00 | 576,000.00 |
| **Variance (underpaid)** | **1,500.00** | **18,000.00** |

- **When it started.** The GL shows $48,000.00 paid every month from January through December.
- **Why.** The schedule's detail ledger lists $48,000.00 for each month, while its summary tab approves $49,500.00. The cause is unresolved.
- **Other partners.** No other partner has a variance.
- **Open item.** Confirm the approved rate with the partners before posting the $18,000.00 catch-up for the full year.
